zh-CN.title: 《大唐西域记》
zh-CN.subtitle: 旅行见闻、地理叙述与知识转译
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《大唐西域记》把求法者的旅行经验转化为关于地理、制度、城市和宗教场所的文本记录。
curatorialDescription: 这部文本既是旅行记录，也是经过选择和组织的知识叙述；博物馆会把观察、传闻和后世解释分开。
它与玄奘人物条目、龟兹和那烂陀地点条目共同构成路线的研究入口。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充具体版本、卷次、译注、异文和不同研究传统对“见闻”与“转述”的区分。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 唐代成书语境；跨区域地理记录

en.title: Record of the Western Regions of the Great Tang
en.subtitle: Travel observation, geography and the translation of knowledge
en.shortSummary: The Record turns a pilgrim's travel experience into an account of geography, institutions, cities and religious sites.
curatorialDescription: It is both a travel record and an organised knowledge narrative; the museum separates observation, report and later interpretation.
Together with the Xuanzang, Kucha and Nalanda entries, it provides a research entry into the route.
en.researchNote: Specific editions, fascicles, translations, variants and distinctions among observation and report still need to be documented.
en.timeLabel: Tang composition context; transregional geographic record
